(() => {
  const node=document.createElement('div');
  node.style.cssText='font:16px/20px serif;width:240px';
  document.body.append(node);
  const rejected = (html,detail,target=node) => {
    node.innerHTML=html;
    try { target.getBoundingClientRect(); return false; }
    catch (error) { return error.message.includes(detail); }
  };
  const result={};
  result.flow=rejected('<a style="white-space:pre">alpha</a><div>beta</div>','mixed inline text flow');
  result.nestedBlock=rejected('<a>alpha<div>beta</div></a>','block inside inline wrapper');
  result.contents=rejected('<a>alpha</a><span style="display:contents">beta</span><div>gamma</div>','text shaping');
  node.innerHTML='<a>alpha</a><div>beta</div>';
  try { node.querySelector('a').getBoundingClientRect(); result.fragment=false; }
  catch (error) { result.fragment=error.message.includes('inline fragment geometry'); }
  result.limit=rejected('x'.repeat(65537)+'<div>beta</div>','layout text source');
  node.innerHTML='<a>alpha</a><div>beta</div>';
  result.recovery=node.getBoundingClientRect().height===40;
  node.remove();
  return result;
})()
